newsitem.title: CHINA: S&P assigns B-minus rating to P.T. Datakom Asia.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns B-minus rating to P.T. Datakom Asia.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it has assigned a B-minus corporate credit rating to Indonesian multimedia holding company P.T. Datakom Asia.
The rating agency also said it has assigned its B-minus long-term rating to the US$225 million senior notes of Pratama Datakom Asia B.V., which are guaranteed by parent Datakom.
S&P said the ratings reflect the company's de facto pay TV monopoly status in Indonesia, strong shareholder support and close relationships with News Corp Ltd.

The strengths are offset by uncertainty of demand for pay TV service in Indonesia, start-up risks related to utilisation of S-band technology in direct broadcasting satellite (DBS) pay TV services and the company's heavy debt usage, S&P said.
Datakom operates Indonesia's sole nationwide pay TV service through its principal subsidiary, PT Matahari Lintas Cakrawala (MLC).

S&P said the company's rating outlook is stable, reflecting its anticipation that Datakom was able to maintain its status as Indonesia's sole pay TV provider in the medium term and its ability to gradually build up its subscriber base.
